subject: Invoice delivery and PO-field mapping — proposed portal-first flow
messages:
From: Olivia Turner <olivia.turner@riversidebikes.com>
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: Finance AP <ap@riversidebikes.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Billing setup question: invoice creation + VAT proof

Hi Rishi,

Hope you're well. We're doing a quick clean-up on our AP intake and wanted to confirm Redwood's recommended approach for receiving monthly invoices and VAT evidence. A couple quick questions: 

- Can Redwood emit invoices from a single company entity (one PDF) and include a VAT ID section that matches our PO?
- Do you support a portal-first delivery (SFTP/API/portal) with auto-email copies to our AP inbox, or do you prefer email-only PDF delivery?
- For PO mapping, which invoice fields do you need to populate to auto-match in our SAP system? Example fields: PO number, remit-to GL, cost center.

Attached is a sample PO from our side for reference (PO_4512.pdf). We also need to make sure VAT evidence (where applicable) is attached or available via a verified link.

Can you confirm options and a recommended default for a smooth go-live? We'd like to lock this by EOD Friday so our AP team can update their intake rules.

Thanks,
Olivia Turner
Finance Manager, Riverside Bikes
ap@riversidebikes.com

Attachments: PO_4512.pdf (PDF, 22KB)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Turner <olivia.turner@riversidebikes.com>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.ai, connor.obrien@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Billing setup question: invoice creation + VAT proof

Hi Olivia — thanks for the clear note and sample PO. Quick summary of what we can offer and my recommendation: 

1) Delivery model (recommended): portal-first (Redwood Console / secure API) as the canonical emitter, with an automated PDF copy emailed to ap@riversidebikes.com per invoice. This gives you:
   - Guaranteed delivery and checksum/URL access to past invoices in case of disputes
   - PDF copies for teams that still require email ingestion rules

2) Invoice format and VAT: we can emit a single PDF per billing entity that includes a VAT ID section and an attached VAT-evidence link (or embedded PDF) when requested. We can also include the VAT ID in the invoice metadata the portal exposes.

3) PO mapping: attached is an example field map (invoice_field_map.csv) we typically use. Minimum fields to auto-match on your side: PO Number, Invoice Date, Net Amount, Billing Entity ID. Optional helpful fields: Cost Center, GL code, Remit-to Account. If you want, Connor can run a short mapping job to align our field names with your SAP import.

Next steps I propose:
- We enable portal delivery and schedule a short handoff call with your AP team (30 minutes).
- Connor will run the PO-field mapping validation using one month of sample invoices.
- Kimberly will confirm SLA for emailed PDFs (within 10 minutes of portal publish) and retention period for VAT evidence.

I attached a sample invoice (Riverside_MonthlyInvoice_SAMPLE.pdf) to show the format we're proposing. If that looks good, we'll schedule the handoff call and toggle the portal option in our onboarding console.

Would Friday EOD work for a final decision?

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai

Attachments: Riverside_MonthlyInvoice_SAMPLE.pdf (PDF, 68KB); invoice_field_map.csv (CSV, 2KB)

From: Olivia Turner <olivia.turner@riversidebikes.com>
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: Finance AP <ap@riversidebikes.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Billing setup question: invoice creation + VAT proof

Thanks Rishi — that all makes sense and the sample PDF looks like it will work. Portal-first with emailed PDF copies is our preferred flow (matches our AP intake architecture). A few clarifying notes: 

- Please make sure the email copy includes the full invoice number in the subject line (we auto-parse subject line for matching).
- We need the VAT evidence attached to the portal record and a link in the PDF header (so auditors can retrieve it during periodic checks).
- For PO mapping, we've confirmed PO number and Cost Center are mandatory. GL codes are optional for now.

Attaching PO_4512.pdf again for Connor's mapping test. Can we schedule the 30-min handoff on Friday at 10:00am PT? If not, any slot between 9–11am PT works.

Best,
Olivia

Subject: Re: Billing setup question: invoice creation + VAT proof — confirmed plan

Hi Olivia / AP team,

Thanks — confirmed on our side. Summary of agreed plan and next actions: 

- Delivery: Portal-first (Redwood Console) will be enabled for Riverside Bikes tomorrow morning (09/18).
- Email copies: PDFs will be auto-emailed to ap@riversidebikes.com with the invoice number in the subject line (format: Redwood Invoice <Invoice #>).
- VAT evidence: will be attached to the portal record and we will insert a short link in the PDF header to the evidence. Retention will be 24 months unless you request longer.
- PO mapping: Connor will start a validation job using PO_4512 and one month of sample invoices. Expected ETA: 2 business days for alignment notes.

Handoff call: Confirmed for Friday 10:00am PT (we'll send a calendar invite — Kimberly adding the join link and SLA notes).

If anything changes on your end, flag it here and we'll adjust. Otherwise we'll execute the toggle tomorrow and share an access link once the portal is live.

Best regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
(rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai)
